idea: A shared job board so independent design studios can track briefs, files, and approvals in one place.
problem: Studios keep client briefs, files, and approvals in email and spreadsheets. That workaround is the evidence of the problem. No separate urgency statistic was opened.
solution_fit: One board would hold the brief, the files, and the approval. Asana, Monday.com, and Notion already cover general team work, and a studio would have to shape that path itself. Switching depends on that setup being slower than email.

market.basis: No census count of design studios was opened for this example.
The customer is independent studios, which is a slice of the design industry, not the whole industry.
No sales capacity or win rate was given.

competitors.name: Asana
competitors.offer: Work management for many kinds of teams.
competitors.difference: The idea is only the studio path of briefs, files, and approvals.

competitors.name: Monday.com
competitors.difference: A studio has to build the approval path. The idea ships that path.

competitors.name: Notion
competitors.difference: Notion is a blank workspace. The idea is the client-approval path.

community.finding: No forum, review, or trend page about this idea was opened.

decision_reason: The problem is a known workaround, and the three opened products are general tools rather than a studio approval path. Market size and public demand were not found on a page, so this is not a go.

assumptions.text: TAM, SAM, and SOM are not calculated. No studio count or willingness to pay was opened.
